caption: The drawing depicts a tall, ornate wooden cabinet composed of two main sections: a lower chest of drawers and an upper armoire with a decorative pediment. The cabinet is shown in both front and side elevation views. The lower section consists of five drawers with curved metal handles, set above four cabriole legs with a scalloped apron and ball-and-claw feet. The upper section features two tall doors with arched tops, each flanked by vertical fluted columns. The top of the cabinet is highly decorated with an elaborate broken-arch pediment, a central finial resembling a shell, and two sculpted figurines positioned on the left and right corners. The entire structure is rendered in black ink outline on a beige background. Clear, straight measurement lines and notations indicate various dimensions, including the overall height (55 ½ inches plus 13 ⅜ inches for the figures), depth (22 inches), and other critical measurements for construction. The composition is symmetrical, and the lines are precise and detailed, reflecting a technical drawing style intended for furniture design or blueprint purposes.
title: Cabinet-top Desk
